headline: Alibaba is reportedly preparing Qwen Go, a personal AI assistant that in trials has handled compensation claims, refunds and bookings on users' behalf.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a big Chinese technology group is testing an assistant that acts for users, but the evidence is one relayed report and one demonstration.
importance_line: Alibaba's customers in China may soon pass routine claims and bookings to an assistant that a person can stop, but the evidence is trial reports and one demonstration relayed by TechNode, with no Alibaba statement, launch date or feature list given.
summary: TechNode reports, citing the Chinese outlet National Business Daily, that Alibaba is preparing to introduce Qwen Go, a personal AI assistant for tasks such as flight-delay compensation claims, shopping refunds, car-servicing appointments and sports-venue bookings. In one shared demonstration it checked a user's flight history, found an eligible delay and negotiated RMB 70 in compensation through text-based customer support after a phone call failed, with its actions visible on screen so the user could step in.
notes: TechNode text read in full (short); the original National Business Daily report in Chinese was not opened.
